video_title: The REAL Reason Wemby Snapped on Minnesota (And Got a Pass)

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby's elbow was justified due to Minnesota's rough play
quotes.quote: Minnesota's been taking, I wouldn't say cheap shots, but just extra shots on Wemby the entire round. Hitting him late, hitting him in the chest, tripping him, pushing him, doing whatever they can to get in his head. I love the fact that he said, 'Fuck y'all' and tried to elbow someone's whole entire head off. I loved it. I also loved because it's not in his character, he doesn't have a reputation that he didn't get suspended for. I thought it was good from a standpoint of, 'Y'all get off me' because if you think back about the series and someone made a great edit, they've been trying to rough him up the whole entire time and he finally had enough and unfortunately Naz Reid's neck had to catch the brunt of that. I'm glad he did it. I'm glad Naz wasn't hurt on the flip side, I don't want no one to be hurt, but I'm glad he let these motherfuckers know he's not a punk.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby should have been fined or suspended despite league ratings
quotes.quote: God damn, they got to take some money from this motherfucker. God damn. He got that little when they kicked him out. I know they got that. But you got to fine this motherfucker, at least suspend him. God damn. I get what I've been listening with everybody been talking about that all day long today, if he should have been suspended or not. I get the league where it's at now, because he's the face of the NBA. People want to see this motherfucker play tonight. They wouldn't want to see, the ratings were going to go way low if this motherfucker wasn't going to play tonight.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Wemby needs a 'goon' on the Spurs to protect him
quotes.quote: Yes, he does. He needs to go, absolutely. He needs to go and handle his, yes. Every star has one. Obviously, this is a very young team, a talented team. Goons don't go for much, because I tell you, I get paid a ton my whole career. But I definitely handled my goonish business. I definitely think an offseason pickup for the San Antonio Spurs needs to be the Wemby protector. Get them a dog. Get them a dog. Yes, that's right. Yes, sir.
